package courseplan

import "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"

// SelectRequestedTargetClosure keeps requested targets and every transitive
// prerequisite. This is the Planner-owned target graph; no external Knowledge
// Tree service is consulted.
func SelectRequestedTargetClosure(graph domain.GoalGraph, requested []domain.TargetRef) (domain.GoalGraph, error) {
	normalized, err := domain.NormalizeGoalGraph(graph)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.GoalGraph{}, err
	}
	if len(requested) == 0 {
		return normalized, nil
	}
	requested, err = domain.NormalizeTargetRefs(requested)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.GoalGraph{}, err
	}
	byID := make(map[string]domain.LearningTarget, len(normalized.Targets))
	for _, target := range normalized.Targets {
		byID[domain.TargetIdentity(target.Ref)] = target
	}
	selected := make(map[string]struct{}, len(requested))
	var include func(domain.TargetRef) error
	include = func(ref domain.TargetRef) error {
		identity := domain.TargetIdentity(ref)
		if _, exists := selected[identity]; exists {
			return nil
		}
		target, exists := byID[identity]
		if !exists {
			return domain.ErrValidation
		}
		selected[identity] = struct{}{}
		for _, prerequisite := range target.Prerequisites {
			if err := include(prerequisite); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		return nil
	}
	for _, ref := range requested {
		if err := include(ref); err != nil {
			return domain.GoalGraph{}, err
		}
	}
	targets := make([]domain.LearningTarget, 0, len(selected))
	for _, target := range normalized.Targets {
		if _, exists := selected[domain.TargetIdentity(target.Ref)]; exists {
			targets = append(targets, target)
		}
	}
	normalized.Targets = targets
	transitions := make([]domain.TransitionKnowledge, 0, len(normalized.Transitions))
	for _, transition := range normalized.Transitions {
		if _, exists := selected[domain.TargetIdentity(transition.Target)]; exists {
			transitions = append(transitions, transition)
		}
	}
	normalized.Transitions = transitions
	return domain.NormalizeGoalGraph(normalized)
}
